SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) vat, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff

calls.statement: SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d2, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'

SELECT f.vat_rate, p.vat_class, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) vat_diff, sum(round(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate,2)) vat_calc, sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount-round(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate,2))>0.011 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mism, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900 AND f.channel_code='ST'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) utc_date_differs, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc + INTERVAL 3 HOUR AS DATE)<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) local_summer_differs, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc + INTERVAL 2 HOUR AS DATE)<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) local_winter_differs, count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-20' AND DATE '2024-09-28'

SELECT f.vat_rate, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, count(*) n FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.vat_rate, s.store_id>=900 AS nonstore, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) net, sum(r.refund_gross-r.refund_net) vat, min(r.return_date), max(r.return_date), count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) d
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) total, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_store, sum(CASE WHEN p.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_prod, sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code='ST' AND s.store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) st_nonstore, sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code='WB' AND s.store_id<900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wb_store, sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code IS NULL OR f.channel_code NOT IN ('ST','WB') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) odd_chan, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) outside_ver
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'

SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, count(f.sales_line_id) n, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN (fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key AND s.store_id<900) ON f.sale_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'FY2024/25' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, f.vat_rate, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_sales, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY f.vat_rate ORDER BY f.vat_rate
